But he knows a lot of dirty secrets about his onetime boss, a medic named Sporg Lutwink. If Mwaloob spills his secrets, I can get Lutwink. But first I need you to bring me Mwaloob. '''Mwaloob''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Medic/Legends|medic]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mwaloob was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Mwaloob spawned under the generic "lost_aqualish_scout" template, his appearance was randomized under one of two possible depictions. He could either appear as male Aqualish or as a female Aqualish. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Mwaloob as male, this article assumes that the male Aqualish depiction is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
